= Cloud July 31, 2026

_July 31, 2026_

[NOTE]
====
Kobiton now uses date-based release versioning. Instead of version numbers such as 4.26S or 4.19.3, releases are identified by date. Build numbers use a format such as 202607.31, and release notes display the corresponding date as July 31, 2026.

== Portal auto-plugin enforcement

*Highlights*

- The automate plugin now declares and enforces per-skill host/platform/file-access rules. Skills that don't meet a caller's environment surface a clear rejection instead of silently mis-executing.

== Reports

- Fixed the Usage Report summary cards showing value rows cut off in the new UI. Values now render fully.

// REVIEWER NOTE:

== Device passcode

- Fixed the Portal not populating the passcode config in `DeviceConfiguration` on the initial device connection. Passcode is now applied on first connection.

// REVIEWER NOTE:
// KOB-52048 | Team: DLM | Deployment: Cloud | ship_date: 2026-07-28 | bucket_source: resolutiondate
// Component: Passcode.

== Scriptless Test Runs

- For Test Cases converted from automation sessions, the Test Run Overview now displays a new action name for each Test Step when Revisit is active. Previously the step used a generic label.
